title: test_sync_e2e drives a refused sync followed by a passing one in the same clone
goal: one sync e2e test runs a refused sync (a stray trailer or a red gate), then the fix (an amend with the trailer) and a passing sync to code/ in the same clone, so a refusal that poisons the next sync fails the suite, which the split of ST-k3e4q43i no longer exercises
notes: Found by the SP-wjp5qllo review (S3): ST-k3e4q43i (3c6ffe0d0) split TestStrayTrailer and test_code_commit_goes_to_a_branch so each assertion survives but the chain refusal -> amend -> push to code/ is gone; the red-gate test now makes its first commit with --no-verify and a plain push. The darwin 6 s per-test bound applies (the review measured the slowest of the three files at 5.37 s).
